Nutritious ragi dosa recipe Ingredients: - 1 cup ragi flour - 1/2 cup semolina (sooji) - 1/2 cup yogurt - 1 tablespoon rice flour - Salt to taste - Water as needed - Oil or ghee for cooking Instructions: 1. In a mixing bowl, combine ragi flour, semolina (sooji), yogurt, rice flour, and salt. 2. Gradually add water and mix well to form a smooth batter with a pouring consistency. Ensure there are no lumps in the batter. 3. Heat a non-stick skillet or dosa tawa over medium heat. Once hot, pour a ladleful of batter onto the center of the tawa. 4. Using the back of the ladle, spread the batter in a circular motion to make a thin dosa. 5. Drizzle some oil or ghee around the edges of the dosa and cook until the bottom turns golden brown and crispy. 6. Flip the dosa and cook the other side for a minute or so. 7. Remove the ragi dosa from the tawa and serve hot with your favorite chutney or sambar. #healthybreakfast #dosa #ragi #nutritious #instantrecipe #healthyfood
